title: An interpretable semiparametric Bayesian machine learning model for high-dimensional circulating epigenetic signatures of multiple myeloma
abstract: arXiv:2605.20143v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Genome-wide 5-hydroxymethylcytosine (5hmC) profiles of circulating cell-free DNA (cfDNA) can reveal epigenetic changes associated with multiple myeloma (MM), but their analysis requires adjusting for known risk factors while selecting a few informative genes from thousands. We propose semiparametric probit Bayesian Additive Regression Tree (spBART), in which the covariates enter a linear component with interpretable coefficients and the genes enter a sparse tree ensemble whose posterior inclusion probabilities select genes conditional on the covariates. The analysis selects eight candidate loci, \textit{IL1RAP}, \textit{ST5}, \textit{HERC6}, \textit{KL}, \textit{MYO1E}, \textit{ELK3}, \textit{CAPN2} and \textit{UBR4}. Selection of \textit{IL1RAP} connects the circulating signature to the \textit{IL-1/IL-6} signaling axis implicated in MM. The final model achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.96

translated_title: 一种用于多发性骨髓瘤高维循环表观遗传特征的可解释半参数贝叶斯机器学习模型
translated_abstract: 循环游离DNA（cfDNA）的全基因组5-羟甲基胞嘧啶（5hmC）谱可以揭示与多发性骨髓瘤（MM）相关的表观遗传变化，但其分析需要在调整已知风险因素的同时，从数千个基因中筛选出少量具有信息量的基因。我们提出了半参数probit贝叶斯加性回归树（spBART）模型，其中协变量进入具有可解释系数的线性成分，而基因则进入一个稀疏的树集成，通过其后验包含概率在协变量条件下进行基因选择。该分析筛选出八个候选基因位点：IL1RAP、ST5、HERC6、KL、MYO1E、ELK3、CAPN2和UBR4。其中IL1RAP的入选将循环表观遗传特征与多发性骨髓瘤相关的IL-1/IL-6信号通路联系起来。最终模型的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）达到0.96。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种可解释的半参数贝叶斯机器学习模型spBART，将线性协变量成分与稀疏树集成相结合，从多发性骨髓瘤患者的循环游离DNA 5hmC数据中筛选出八个关键基因位点（包括与IL-1/IL-6信号通路相关的IL1RAP），模型AUC达到0.96。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes spBART, an interpretable semiparametric Bayesian machine learning model that combines a linear covariate component with a sparse tree ensemble to select eight key gene loci (including IL1RAP linked to the IL-1/IL-6 signaling axis) from high-dimensional circulating cfDNA 5hmC profiles for multiple myeloma, achieving an AUC of 0.96.
